contexts.text: Festivity and joy on account of good having been implanted. Signified.

All festivity and gladness is from the delights of the loves in which the man is... All festivity has consent interiorly in it; for if anything dissents and opposes, the festivity perishes. Interior festivity exists in man's freedom; and all freedom is from love to which there is nothing contrary.
Weddings are to be celebrated with festivity. Explained.
There are festivities when marriages take place, but with a difference in the Societies.
